Shortwave radios can be found in many common and affordable packages. It's a misconception that you need a HUGE antenna to pick up broadcasts from around the globe. I have a large collection of antique radios from the era when shortwave could be a metaphor for the internet of the 30s and 40s. Shortwave radio waves bounce off the atmosphere and can travel long distances with minimal amounts of power. I can turn on one of my old radios from here in Florida and pick up broadcasts from all around the world. One of these radios would cost you less than your cellphone or a month of internet service in most places. Some of the best ones are the Zenith Trans-Oceanic models. Realistic made affordable radios as well as late as the 1990s. You can find them everywhere and the only technical experience you need to operate one is the ability to turn it on and adjust the dial until you find something interesting to listen to. Good luck and happy hunting out there! Shortwave Radio Guide
